name: Heroic Captain Kromcrush can be kited beyond his old 30-yard leash
contract: Issues #13849 and #13847: on Heroic and Mythic, Captain Kromcrush (14325) and Stomper Kreeg (14322) reset about 30 yards from their spawns, so kiting, a fear or a charge reset them. Expected (proposal, to be confirmed in game): both use the 50-yard circle most bosses have. The same change gives Rethilgore (3914) that circle instead of his cell polygon (#13835) and Baron Silverlaine (3887) and Razorclaw the Butcher (3886) 90 yards, so they can be pulled into each other's room as on Ascension (#13836); those are not covered here.

steps.label: p stands at Captain Kromcrush's spawn in a Heroic Dire Maul
CONTROL: Kromcrush follows p more than 30 yards from his spawn
DISCRIMINATING: Kromcrush stays in combat beyond 30 yards (his 30-yard leash reset him before)
